ASEGURAMIENTO
To: [Bank Name]
In accordance with Article 160 of the fiscal code, as amended, and Article 142 of the credit institutions law, it is hereby ordered that you freeze all assets belonging to Heredia y Franco e Hijos, up to a total amount of seven million four hundred fifty-five thousand pesos (7,455,000.00 MXN), including but not limited to, deposits, accounts, credits, and any other financial instruments or property held in your institution.
The purpose of this asset freeze is to ensure that the funds are preserved for the benefit of the Mexican authorities, pending the outcome of an ongoing investigation and potential enforcement actions by the relevant government agencies. Therefore, you are hereby instructed to take immediate action to freeze all assets belonging to Heredia y Franco e Hijos in your institution, without prejudice to any rights or interests you may have.
Furthermore, it is essential that you report back to this authority, within a period of five business days from the date of receipt of this Aseguramiento, providing detailed information regarding the frozen assets, including but not limited to: account numbers, account names, and the current balances. Additionally, please confirm whether any transactions have been made on these accounts since the date of this order.
You are also required to maintain a record of all correspondence, documents, and communication related to this Aseguramiento, which must be kept confidential and available for inspection by our authorities upon request.
Failure to comply with the terms and conditions set forth in this Aseguramiento may result in serious consequences, including but not limited to, fines, penalties, and legal actions. Therefore, it is imperative that you take immediate and diligent action to freeze all assets belonging to Heredia y Franco e Hijos and report back to us as instructed.
Please confirm receipt of this Aseguramiento and indicate your compliance with the instructions set forth herein.
